name: i18n — always use t() for UI strings
description: Never hardcode UI strings in TSX/TS files; always add to i18n.ts and use t() from the start
type: feedback
---

Always use the i18n system (`t()` via `useT()`) for every visible UI string in this project. Never hardcode strings directly in JSX or component logic.

**Why:** The project has full EN/TR localization. Hardcoded strings bypass this and accumulate as debt that requires periodic audits to clean up.

- All data pages use `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"`
- Supabase client is lazy (initialized on first call, not module load)
- Don't pass Database generic to createClient — use `as TypeName[]` casts instead
- Server components fetch data → pass to `*-client.tsx` Client components
- Server Actions in `actions.ts` files handle all mutations
- Dynamic sidebar colors use **inline CSS styles** (not Tailwind dynamic classes) to avoid purge issues
- Logout uses `window.location.href = "/login"`

If `Cannot find module './NNN.js'` appears after adding files:
→ `kill $(lsof -ti :3000) && rm -rf .next && npm run dev`

- RLS is enabled on all tables (owner_id = auth.uid())
- Auth is fully implemented (login page, middleware, session management)
- All reads and writes are scoped to `getCurrentUserId()` (from supabase-server.ts)
- Tables without owner_id (leases, payments, maintenance_fees) are scoped via property chain: get owner property IDs → lease IDs → filter
- Public pages in middleware: `/login`, `/signup`, `/maintenance`
